intentSummary: Enhance the existing URL shortener with expiring links and click analytics without breaking current contracts or tests.

functionalRequirements.title: Expiring links
functionalRequirements.description: POST /links accepts an optional expiresAt UTC timestamp; resolving an expired code returns 410 Gone; links without expiresAt never expire.
functionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: expiring links — POST /links accepts an optional expiresAt ... returns 410 Gone

functionalRequirements.title: Click analytics
functionalRequirements.description: Record every successful redirect and expose GET /links/{code}/stats returning total click count and last-clicked timestamp.

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Backward compatibility
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Do not break the existing POST /links and GET /{code} contracts; all existing tests must continue to pass.
nonFunctionalRequirements.sourceExcerpt: do not break the existing ... contracts; all existing tests must continue to pass

nonFunctionalRequirements.title: Reuse existing abstraction
nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Follow the existing code style and the existing ILinkStore abstraction.

assumptions.text: expiresAt is provided and compared in UTC.
assumptions.rationale: The requirement specifies a UTC timestamp.
